data.title: England’s plan for Rio Ngumoha now confirmed after latest developments - Yahoo Sports
data.content: # England’s plan for Rio Ngumoha now confirmed after latest developments. ## Rio Ngumoha handed England selection boost ahead of Croatia and Czechia fixtures. Rio Ngumoha's latest England milestone could be followed by further opportunities, with a reduced squad improving the Liverpool forward's prospects of involvement against Croatia and Czechia. The teenager made his competitive international debut in Tuesday's 2-0 victory in Prague, having been omitted from Thomas Tuchel's matchday squad for the opening Nations League fixture against Spain. For Ngumoha, it offers a clearer route into the squad for the remaining matches, although earning minutes remains a separate challenge. England confirmed that the Manchester City defender had returned to his club for assessment after missing the win over Czechia. No replacement is being added ahead of the trip to Croatia on 3 October and the return meeting with Czechia at Wembley on 6 October. Equally, his involvement with England gives him an opportunity to return to Liverpool with more competitive experience behind him.
